description: compile_patch(screen, patch): reassignments, data paths, del() and theme() against an existing surface; only what changed is sent, and applying the messages equals compiling the new screen.

cases.name: patch_reassign_one_component
cases.screen:
theme(primary=#2563eb)
style(card, "col g8 p16 bg-card r-lg")
root = Column([title, list, save], s="col g16 p24")
title = Text("Tasks", variant="title")
list = Column([a, b], s=card)
a = Text($/items/0)
b = Text($/items/1)
save = Button("Save", action=Event("save"))
$/items = ["Write", "Ship"]
$/user = {name: "Ada", role: "admin"}
cases.screen_after:
theme(primary=#2563eb)
style(card, "col g8 p16 bg-card r-lg")
root = Column([title, list, save], s="col g16 p24")
title = Text("Today", variant="title")
list = Column([a, b], s=card)
a = Text($/items/0)
b = Text($/items/1)
save = Button("Save", action=Event("save"))
$/items = ["Write", "Ship"]
$/user = {name: "Ada", role: "admin"}
